content:
Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

Nomination: If the employee has a "family", he shall make such nomination only in favour of a member or members of his "family". However, a female subscriber can exclude her husband from her family for the purpose of this Scheme by a notice in writing to the Head of Office.  
- "Family" means husband, wife or wives, parents, children, a ward, minor brothers, unmarried sisters, deceased son's widow and children, and where none of the parents of the members of the Scheme is alive, a paternal grandparent.
